property_summary: In the reference contract, only the owner can successfully change the bet limit via AdjustBetAmounts; in the buggy version, a non-owner can also succeed, so a non-owner call to AdjustBetAmounts should never change currentBetLimit() for P but can for M.
change_summary: Replace the require condition in onlyOwner with 'require(msg.sender != owner);' so non-owners can call AdjustDifficulty.
